METALWORK — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

4. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.

5. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.

8. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.

9. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.

10. When learning Forging, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Forging.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.

11. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

12. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.

13. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

14. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Assembly Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Assembly Drawings.

15. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork related businesses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
